crop.notes: Whole 'News Notes and Comments' column of unrelated one-line items; only the Richard K. Fox item (piece 5) is about Allen. Last strip is from the next column (walking match).

ocr.notes: The Allen item is transcribed correctly

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican noted that Richard K. Fox wanted to back Tom Allen against John L. Sullivan or any other pugilist for the championship of the world.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Tuesday Morning, October 31, 1882, page 4 (Missouri Republican); not yet the St. Louis Republic

facts.fact: Richard K. Fox offered to back Allen against John L. Sullivan or any other pugilist for the championship of the world
